entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.Monitor_1.4.0-beta.6

1.4.0-beta.6 (2026-11-10)

Features Added

  • Added managed identity support to autoscale settings.
  • Added tenant action group management and test notification operations.

Breaking Changes

  • VM Insights onboarding status JSON now uses generated serialization for the required resourceId, onboardingStatus, and dataStatus fields instead of the legacy omission and null-tolerant customization.

Bugs Fixed

  • Restored generated diagnostic setting operations, model serialization, and model factory support instead of throwing compatibility stubs.

Azure.Data.AI_1.0.0

1.0.0 (2026-11-10)

Features Added

  • First stable release of the Azure.Data.AI client library for semantic reranking.
  • Supports the generally available service API version 2026-10-30.

Breaking Changes

  • Renamed SemanticRerankingInferenceContent to SemanticRerankingContent, SemanticRerankingInferenceResult to SemanticRerankingResult, and SemanticRerankingMetaResult to SemanticRerankingMetadata, including the corresponding model factory methods.
  • Renamed the result's Meta property to Metadata; the JSON property remains meta.
  • Changed TargetPaths from a settable string to an IList<string> collection with an API contract limit of 100 paths.
